usable_improvement: An honest existing-runtime location map for later source work, without changing the machine or inspecting the original Snow archive.
research_question: Does PATH or either immediate Applications directory expose an existing named Blender executable candidate?
decision: Choose a concrete candidate path for a separate future version/source gate if found; otherwise defer the Snow CPU inquiry under this discovery scope. No globalabsence or installation claim.

bounds.bundle_match: Immediate .app entry whose name contains Blender, case insensitive; no recursive discovery.
bounds.metadata: Only matching bundle Contents/Info.plist <=65536bytes; return CFBundleIdentifier/CFBundleExecutable/CFBundleShortVersionString/CFBundleVersion and candidate executable stat/xaccess/resolvedpath. PATH uses shutil.which, no process invocation.
bounds.directory_absence: Record as a bounded negative source result, not globalabsence or automatic stop on missingroot. Stop on unreadable/malformed/excessive data without retry/expansion.
